title: Night-Owl Microphone
what: A caller's message streamed in real time, as if from a microphone. Partial guesses arrive while she is still talking and settle into final text: this replay keeps the exact moment each one came in.

inputs.label: Model
inputs.value: Scribe v2 Realtime (WebSocket, 16 kHz PCM, 100 ms chunks)

inputs.label: What she says
inputs.value: [sleepy] Hi... um, hi, Night Radio. I've never called a radio show before. I'm Sofía, I'm a night nurse, and I just finished my shift. [sighs] It's raining, the bus is late, and honestly, your show is the only thing keeping me awake. Could you play something soft? Something for everyone who's still working tonight. [laughs softly] Okay. Thank you. Bye. Oh, wait. Thank you!

snippet:
token = requests.post("https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/single-use-token/realtime_scribe",
    headers={"xi-api-key": KEY}).json()["token"]
# in the browser: no key, only the one-time token
ws = new WebSocket(`wss://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/speech-to-text/realtime?model_id=scribe_v2_realtime&token=${token}`)
ws.send(JSON.stringify({message_type: "input_audio_chunk", audio_base_64: chunk, sample_rate: 16000}))
